verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Zulip has a public API with a send-message endpoint, a bot framework built on it, and incoming webhooks. Nothing shows the API reaches parity with the UI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common paths, so coverage cannot be checked. Missing for 10: evidence that UI actions such as topic creation, channel subscription, search filters, admin and permissions settings, and export are exposed through the API; an API reference or OpenAPI spec showing endpoint coverage; independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
